fact: Article 21 of Ley 7/2024 of 23 December 2024 creates the National Agency for Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructures (ANCIC) as an autonomous public body under the Presidency of the Government, with functions to manage cybersecurity through coordinated CERT/CSIRT teams, issue alerts on cyber incidents and respond to them.
system: Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad e Infraestructuras Críticas (ANCIC)
